checked_obligation: Under the forward-implication assumption that a is a primitive root modulo p, verify that ord_p(-a)=(p-1)/2 from n3 and n4.
reason: Let d=ord_p(-a). By n3, (-a)^((p-1)/2)≡1 mod p, so d divides (p-1)/2. By n4 applied to n=d, (p-1)/2 divides d. Hence d=(p-1)/2. No listed external group theorem is needed.
